name: Josh Brecheen
stance: Co-chaired a hearing on AI cyber threats after the reported Chinese hijacking of Claude, and calls for monitoring AI against vulnerabilities.

statements.text: Co-chaired a House Homeland Security hearing on AI and cybersecurity, following the reported hijacking of Anthropic's Claude by Chinese state hackers.
Congress must stand alert to the fact that Communist China is actively working to weaponize AI, and other emerging technologies, to harm America.
Congress must work to Constitutionally ensure that AI is properly monitored against vulnerabilities.
